turpan.translation: 吐鲁番[新疆维吾尔自治区](旧译Turfan)

turpentine.definition:
n. obtained from conifers (especially pines)
n. volatile liquid distilled from turpentine oleoresin; used as paint thinner and solvent and medicinally
turpentine.translation:
n. 松脂, 松木油, 松节油
vt. 涂以松节油

turpentine camphor.translation: [医] 松节油脑, 松油二醇

turpeth.definition:
n. The root of Ipom/a Turpethum, a plant of Ceylon, Malabar,
   and Australia, formerly used in medicine as a purgative; -- sometimes
   called vegetable turpeth.
n. A heavy yellow powder, Hg3O2SO4, which consists of a basic
   mercuric sulphate; -- called also turpeth mineral.
turpeth.translation: n. 印度喇叭花[牵牛花]

turpis contractus.translation: [法] 不道德合同, 非法合同

turpitude.definition: n a corrupt or depraved or degenerate act or practice
turpitude.translation:
n. 卑鄙行为, 卑鄙
[法] 邪恶, 可耻行为, 卑鄙

turps.definition:
n volatile liquid distilled from turpentine oleoresin; used as paint thinner and solvent and medicinally
n removal of significant amounts of prostate tissue (as in cases of benign prostatic hyperplasia)
turps.translation:
n. 松节油
[医] 松节油
